title: Vowelthroat Scream
prompt: nasty droning bass and drum line
description: A sawtooth formant voice held in the mid register, screaming and talking as it steps through vowels across the loop while a slow triangle LFO drags a resonant band-pass back and forth through its throat. Deep vibrato makes it seasick and a cavernous room tail gives it an alien hollow scream that never quite lands on a word.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 [c4 d4] f4 eb4 [g4 f4] eb4 c4 [d4 eb4]>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o e a o u>/2")
    .vib(tri.slow(13).range(2.5, 8)).vibmod(tri.slow(23).range(0.4, 1.6))
    .bpf(tri.slow(16).range(420, 3200)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(9, 18)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.18)
    .attack(0.02).decay(0.2).sustain(0.7).release(0.12)
    .shape(tri.slow(19).range(0.12, 0.42)).crush(sine.slow(29).range(16, 7))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.32, 0.68))
    .sometimesBy(0.14, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/6, x => x.add(note(12)).vowel("<u o>/2").gain(0.24).room(0.6))
    .room(sine.slow(32).range(0.45, 0.85)).roomsize(8)
    .gain(0.82)
)
